evidence: Modifies src/wallet/migrate.cpp and tool_wallet.py to handle corrupted Berkeley DB overflow pages during wallet migration and dumping.
rationale: Fixes an infinite loop in BerkeleyRODatabase::Open when parsing empty circular overflow pages. On corrupted BDB wallets, 'migratewallet or bitcoin-wallet dump to spin indefinitely at 100% CPU on an HTTP worker thread and blocks node shutdown', but handling crafted corrupted wallet files is reasonably deferrable.
